newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SAirGroup baffled by newspaper advert.
newsitem.headline: SAirGroup baffled by newspaper advert.

text.p: SAirGroup was baffled on Friday by an advertisement in a Swiss newspaper about the creation of a new airline in the United States, "Swissair Connection".
"It must be a bad joke," said a spokesman for SAirGroup, which includes the flagcarrier Swissair airline.
The advertisement was carried by the influentIal Neue Zuercher Zeitung (NZZ) and said SAirGroup was expected to participate with a 25 percent stake in the company's share capital.
"Swissair Connection intends to offer flight service within America under Swiss management and comfort," the advertisement said.
"SAirGroup has no such plans," the spokesman said, adding SAirGroup's legal department was looking into the matter.
The advertisement did not provide any details of who was behind the plan for a new airline, but included an e-mail address, asking potential investors to write.
